answer: Seed the grading garden with honeypots whose wrongness is machine-checkable yet whose surface wears the velvet of a real submission — proper length, required words, fluent as a sonnet. A grader approving one is caught against ground truth with zero human judgment and slashed; an honest grader scores it low on merit. The gap between verdict and known-bad is the signal, cheap and exact, and no colluder can tell trap from genuine before grading it.
